title: Support Orchestrator: task-pack for admin utilities and runbook automation
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Goal: Deliver a composable task-pack for Support Orchestrator that turns operational runbooks into idempotent, testable tasks callable from the operator UI, CLI, and Slack. This ticket scopes the minimal viable task library (ops-runner) plus automation hooks to reduce manual incident toil and enable safe self-service admin utilities for SRE/Support.

Context: We currently have ad-hoc scripts and runbooks stored in a mix of Confluence pages and repo scripts. This causes drift, inconsistent RBAC, and manual steps during incidents. The task-pack will: 1) provide a canonical set of admin actions (cache flush, KV eviction, model rollbacks, capacity drain), 2) enforce parameter validation and audit logging, 3) expose actions via a web operator console and Slack slash commands, and 4) include a lightweight simulation harness for freeze-mode canary testing of runbook tasks without touching prod state.
acceptance_criteria: ops-runner library implemented with 8 initial task templates: cache-clear, kv-prune, node-drain, model-fallback, quota-reset, key-rotate, diagnostic-gather, and incident-annotate
Each task is idempotent and supports dry-run and confirm flags
Tasks expose structured metadata (inputs, outputs, estimated duration) and publish audit events to the platform audit stream
Operator console shows a task run history with links to correlated audit log entries and triggered alerts
Slack slash-command integration for /runbook with parameterized invocations and ephemeral confirmation flow
Simulation harness can run tasks in readonly mode against a sandbox environment and produce a deterministic report
End-to-end tests added and green in CI; basic load test shows 100 concurrent task launches with no service degradation
steps: Design task interface (inputs/outputs/validation) and store in ops-runner schema registry
Implement core ops-runner library in Go with plugin hooks for cloud provider and infra APIs
Add audit+tracing integration (Datadog events + internal audit stream) to every task invocation
Wire UI: Add "Runbook -> Tasks" page in Console with parameter forms and run history
Implement Slack slash-command backend and confirmation modal using existing Slack app
Build simulation harness and sample sandbox run using test fixtures from infra-team
Write unit/integration tests and a simple chaos scenario exercising model-fallback task
Create migration plan and doc for deprecating ad-hoc scripts and mapping them to tasks
